info.title: ShopEase Product Service
info.description:
Catalog, categories, prices and inventory. Reads are public; changes need the admin role. Stock reservations for checkout are internal, all-or-nothing, idempotent per order and safe under concurrency; every stock change is audited.

All errors use the ShopEase envelope (`ErrorResponse`). Every response carries `X-Request-ID`. Public routes (`/api/...`) are reached through the API Gateway on port 8000 with the same paths; `/internal/...` routes are for other services only. Use **Authorize** with an access token from `POST /api/auth/login`. Contracts: `docs/rest_api_notes.md`.
